results.rationale: Buildings and streets replace a substantial area of forest left of the highway, correctly depicting urbanization and fewer trees. Right-side roof details and highway vehicles also change. The aerial layout is coherent, but newly added rooftops have conspicuous mottled, eroded-looking textures and some irregular geometry.

The sky is brighter and stars are enlarged, but no auroral curtains or bands appear. Foreground vegetation and its illumination also change despite the retained mountain outline. Maze-like texture across the sky is an obvious artifact. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.
